stem: A company wants to automatically generate a short written summary of a lengthy legal contract, producing entirely new sentences rather than extracting existing ones verbatim. Which category of AI capability is this?

explanation.why_correct: Producing new sentences that summarize a source document is a content-creation task, the defining characteristic of generative AI.

why_incorrect.B: Classification assigns an input to a predefined category; it does not produce new written content.
why_incorrect.C: Anomaly detection identifies unusual data points; it has no relationship to generating new text.

explanation.rule_of_thumb: If the system produces brand-new content rather than only labeling or scoring, it's generative AI.
